content: These three timestamp features model the time aspect of the online stream of news data and help disambiguate clustering decisions, since time is a valuable indicator that a news story has changed, even if a cluster representation has a reasonable match in the textual features with the incoming document. The same way a news story becomes popular and fades over time BIBREF2 , we model the probability of a document belonging to a cluster (in terms of timestamp difference) with a probability distribution.
